scope: Local SM90 PF; FP8 forward, Dgrad and Wgrad; FP32 accumulation and BF16 dW. E256/top-8. Prequantized weights prepared once. Excludes optimizer and requantization after updates. BF16 includes its default weight packing.
methodology: GPU benchmarks ran sequentially after correctness tests and builds. Five warmups, twenty samples; median of each sample's slowest rank wall time. Same routing and token sequences for all three variants. Final builds omit task timing instrumentation.
limitations: GIN multi-node path compiled but not run.
Throughput results are fixed-weight forward+backward, not a complete optimizer step.
changes: Asynchronous TMA copies for Wgrad scales.
Compact FP8 data and scale planes within each existing M128 ring slot; preserve multicast and slot retirement.
Warp-per-row-group backward SwiGLU and shared column-scale reduction.
Reuse GMMA descriptors, avoid redundant accumulator clears and proxy fences, skip empty math warpgroups.

experiments.name: n128
experiments.note: Dgrad N128 alone increased device Dgrad time.

experiments.name: tma
experiments.note: Copy contiguous Wgrad scales with operand TMA.

experiments.name: rowwarp
experiments.note: SwiGLU warp owns 16 rows and four adjacent channels per lane.

experiments.name: packed
experiments.note: Unicast A changed the cluster credit protocol; large workloads timed out. Final version retains A multicast.

experiments.name: packed-multicast
experiments.note: Per-M128-slot compact FP8 data and transposed scale plane; multicast A plus bulk scale copy.

experiments.name: pipe-only
experiments.note: Two N64 fragments did not improve latency.

experiments.name: fused-du
experiments.note: Correctness passed, but direct dU/SwiGLU fusion did not improve device latency.

experiments.name: desc
experiments.note: Reuse descriptor low words; ScaleOut::Zero eliminates repeated register clearing.

experiments.name: async
experiments.note: Remove ordinary-store proxy fence only for TMA-produced WGMMA operands.

experiments.name: release
experiments.note: Retained empty-warpgroup tail skipping. Reverted early stage release because its timing benefit was negligible.

experiments.name: dw128
experiments.note: Wgrad N128 increased device weight-gradient time.

experiments.name: post
experiments.note: Moving row-to-column conversion after GEMM failed dW2 numerical parity; timing is not a valid result.

experiments.name: kpipeline
experiments.note: Cross-K N128 double accumulators passed parity but regressed latency; ptxas emitted C7514/C7517 serialization warnings.

experiments.name: kpipeline232
experiments.note: Compiled with 232 math registers; compiler serialization persisted. Not retained.
